findings.title: Public group member lists are truncated with no way to fetch subsequent pages
findings.body: The public members route now calls findMembers() with its default limit of 50, and the server applies that limit to every group. However, the public members template has no pagination controls or load-more behavior. A custom group with more than 50 members, which previously displayed all members, now permanently hides everyone after the first 50. Add pagination to the public page or preserve its complete member listing.

findings.title: Exact multiples of the page size produce an extra empty page
findings.body: totalPages uses floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which overcounts whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the limit. For example, a 50-member group with limit 50 displays two pages and enables Next; clicking it requests offset 50 and displays an empty member list. Use ceiling division for the number of pages.

findings.title: Existing membership PATCH requests now silently change group visibility
findings.body: The previous update action supported PATCH /admin/groups/:id with changes.add and changes.delete, as demonstrated by the removed incremental-update tests. The route still accepts PATCH, but this action now ignores changes and unconditionally sets visible to false when no visible parameter is supplied. Existing clients therefore receive a successful response without the requested membership change, while also unexpectedly hiding the group. Preserve the PATCH contract or explicitly reject unsupported requests without modifying the group.

findings.title: Removing the final member on a page leaves pagination at an invalid offset
findings.body: removeMember reloads members using the existing offset without moving back when the current page becomes empty. For example, removing the only member on page 3 of a 101-member group leaves offset 100 after the total falls to 100. Subsequent reloads still return an empty list because findMembers clamps the offset to the member count rather than to the start of the last valid page. Normalize the offset to a valid page after membership removal so the administrator sees the remaining members.
